Plus the DSGVO-generator cross-check (LEGAL.md §7.8) as a second pair of eyes.

The drafts are careful and test-covered. Neither of those makes them *reviewed*, and **this is the
one item on the go-live list that no amount of engineering substitutes for.** A test can prove the
German and English versions have the same keys; it cannot tell you the German makes a claim the
project cannot support.

Sequenced after the re-check deliberately — paying someone to review a document that still
describes proposed infrastructure wastes the review.
